title: Triggers in 4D v11 SQL
author: Atanas Atanassov, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D table triggers (On Saving New/Existing Record, On Deleting Record events)
cascading triggers, TRIGGER LEVEL and TRIGGER PROPERTIES commands
VARIABLE TO VARIABLE / GET PROCESS VARIABLES / SET PROCESS VARIABLES

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D's classic table-level trigger mechanism, which fires uniformly regardless of whether records are modified via the 4D language, forms, SQL, ODBC, or the web — a design that has proven durable. Triggers remain a core, actively supported part of 4D today and are still the recommended place to enforce table-level data integrity, though ORDA (4D v16 R5+, 2017) adds complementary entity-level events (e.g. onSaving, onDeleting datastore class events) for object-oriented / REST-driven data access. The concurrency and process-variable details described (parallel trigger execution introduced in v11, per-trigger process variable tables) are still accurate to how classic triggers behave today.
related_updates: ORDA datastore class events (onSaving, onDeleting, onLoad, etc., 4D v17+) provide an entity/REST-oriented complement to classic table triggers
